data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to query app package info like version, build number and installer store.
data.what_it_does: Provides a cross‑platform API to read the application name, package identifier, version, build number and the store that installed the app. Supports Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows and Web.
use_when: You need to display or log the app's version/build information.
You want to redirect users to the correct app store for ratings or updates.
avoid_when: You require real‑time device sensors or hardware info unrelated to the app package.
strengths: Full platform coverage including web and desktop.
Provides installerStore info for store‑specific flows.
Zero runtime dependencies beyond Flutter core.
weaknesses: Requires native configuration for each platform (e.g., Gradle, Xcode).
Installer store may be null on some Android devices.
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec.yaml; on Android ensure Gradle and Kotlin versions meet requirements; on iOS configure minimum iOS version and run pod install; no extra permissions needed.

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers broader device hardware details but also includes package info; useful if you need both sets of data.
